title: Get more comfort and save more energy with a free home assessment
summary: As the days begin to cool and fall settles into New Orleans, now is the perfect time to prepare your home for the season ahead.
body_markdown:
As the days begin to cool and fall settles into New Orleans, now is the perfect time to prepare your home for the season ahead. If some rooms never seemed to stay comfortable this summer, your air conditioner worked overtime or your energy bills were higher than expected, your home could be losing more energy than you realize.


Hidden air leaks, insulation gaps, and heating and cooling inefficiencies can affect your home’s comfort, performance and energy use without obvious signs. A free Energy Smart home assessment can help uncover these issues and provide personalized recommendations to improve comfort, reduce energy waste and connect you with available rebates.


Whether you own or rent, a home assessment is the first step toward getting more from your home. You’ll gain a better understanding of how your home uses energy and learn about opportunities to improve efficiency, increase comfort and lower monthly utility costs.


**What you can expect during a free home assessment**


Every home is different, so every home assessment is personalized to your home’s unique needs. During your visit, an Energy Smart advisor will help you:


- Get more comfort by identifying hidden air leaks, insulation gaps and airflow issues that can affect indoor comfort.
- Get more efficiency by evaluating how your heating and cooling system is performing and identifying opportunities to reduce energy waste.
- Get more value with personalized recommendations that help you prioritize improvements to enhance your home’s overall performance.
- Save more by connecting you with available Energy Smart rebates and incentives that can help make eligible upgrades more affordable.


During your visit, your Energy Smart advisor may also install free energy-saving products, such as a smart thermostat, advanced power strip, faucet aerator, showerhead or pipe insulation, if they’re right for your home.


Small improvements like these can make a meaningful difference. By understanding how your home performs today, you’ll be better prepared to make informed decisions that improve comfort, increase efficiency and support long-term energy savings.


**Take the first step toward more comfort**


A free Energy Smart home assessment is the easiest way to discover how you can get more comfort, efficiency and value from your home.


Renters in buildings with four or fewer units are eligible for a free home assessment. Additional upgrades will require your landlord’s permission.


[Start saving today](https://energysmartnola.info/residents/home-energy-assessments/?utm_source=eno&utm_medium=newsletter&utm_campaign=September+Circuit)
